programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Eliane Elias
programme.desc: There's no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil', seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards', and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards' in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist. In this concert broadcast, recorded live at the Philharmonie in Munich, Elias shows her distinctive and immediately recognizable musical style, which blends her Brazilian samba roots and her sensuous, alluring voice with her impressive instrumental bebop, jazz, classical, and compositional skills. She is an artist beyond category, and in this concert she performs with Jay Randall Anderson (bass) and Adam Nussbaum (drums).

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Art Farmer, Jim Hall, Steve Swallow & Pete La Roca
programme.sub-title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64 highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer's band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins' band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: George Thorogood & the Destroyers
programme.desc: George Thorogood is an American icon. In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, he and his band The Destroyers have released 16 studio albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival. Performing at an event that had previously played host to many of their musical heroes inspired the band to produce one of their finest performances on a set list that stretched back to their eponymous debut album from 1977 and right up to their most recent releases. This is goodtime rocking blues and nobody does it better than George Thorogood & The Destroyers.

programme.title: Paul Simon
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

Enjoy the biggest hits of the decade's most important artist: "Because You Loved Me", "All By Myself", "My Heart Will Go On", "I Drove All Night" and others!

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver

From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Eliane Elias
programme.desc: There's no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil', seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards', and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards' in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist. In this concert broadcast, recorded live at the Philharmonie in Munich, Elias shows her distinctive and immediately recognizable musical style, which blends her Brazilian samba roots and her sensuous, alluring voice with her impressive instrumental bebop, jazz, classical, and compositional skills. She is an artist beyond category, and in this concert she performs with Jay Randall Anderson (bass) and Adam Nussbaum (drums).

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Art Farmer, Jim Hall, Steve Swallow & Pete La Roca
programme.sub-title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64 highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer's band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins' band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Foo Fighters
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: George Thorogood & the Destroyers
programme.desc: George Thorogood is an American icon. In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, he and his band The Destroyers have released 16 studio albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival. Performing at an event that had previously played host to many of their musical heroes inspired the band to produce one of their finest performances on a set list that stretched back to their eponymous debut album from 1977 and right up to their most recent releases. This is goodtime rocking blues and nobody does it better than George Thorogood & The Destroyers.

programme.title: Paul Simon
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: Céline Dion
programme.sub-title: Celine Dion - Taking Chances World Tour
programme.desc: Part of the world tour of Celine Dion, which was seen by more than 3 million people and covered 5 continents, 25 countries and 92 cities - the first tour in nine years that was an absolute success. Enjoy the biggest hits of the decade's most important artist: "Because You Loved Me", "All By Myself", "My Heart Will Go On", "I Drove All Night" and others!

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras mujeres

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Zona de caza
programme.desc: Una madre huye de su marido mafioso y de sus peligrosos sicarios que intentan darle caza. Desesperada por encontrar un escondite para ella y sus hijos, se refugia en la cabaña del bosque de un excursionista llamado Jake.

programme.title: Tránsito
programme.desc: Historia de suspense de un psiquiatra de Nueva York que intenta detener el suicidio planeado de un joven paciente inusual en la víspera de su 21 cumpleaños.

programme.title: El proyecto de la bruja de Blair
programme.desc: EL PROYECTO DE LA BRUJA DE BLAIR sigue a tres cineastas en un supuesto paseo por el bosque que se convierte en un viaje terrorífico. Cuando se pierden, también pierden los ánimos. Empiezan a tener hambre y lanzar acusaciones.

programme.title: Infiel
programme.desc: El matrimonio de Edward y Connie Sumner parece ir bien. Pero un día, en Manhattan, Connie conoce a Paul, un atractivo coleccionista de libros de origen francés. Ambos comienzan una relación adúltera de insospechadas consecuencias...

programme.title: Un atardecer en la Toscana
programme.desc: La ganadora del Premio Nobel, Maria Linde (Krystyna Janda), una mujer de espíritu libre que vive junto a su familia en la cálida Toscana, mantiene un affaire con un joven egipcio dueño de un hotel de la playa cercana.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: Historia romántica teñida de crimen que te mantiene al borde del asiento. Baron (Joe Keery), recientemente encarcelado, entabla amistad con su compañero de celda Otis (Aldis Hodge), un hombre con un amplio historial de fugas de prisión.

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: Excelente y multipremiada cinta basada en hechos reales sobre la escalofriante historia de un profesor que, para explicar los regímenes autoritarios, idea un expermiento consistente en implantar un régimen de extrema disciplina militar en el aula. El experimento se convertirá en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Monos
programme.desc: En la cima de una imponente montaña, donde lo que a primera vista parece un campamento de verano, ocho niños guerrilleros apodados “Los Monos» conviven bajo la atenta mirada de un sargento paramilitar. Su única misión es clara: cuidar a la doctora, una americana a la que han tomado como rehén.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Siete días y una vida
programme.desc: El mundo perfecto de una bella reportera de televisión Seattle queda desmoronado por la predicción de su muerte en siete días.

programme.title: Abajo el amor
programme.desc: Nueva York, 1962. Barbara Novak es una escritora feminista cuyo libro "Abajo el amor", se ha convertido en la guía que siguen las mujeres de todo el mundo. Convencido de que Novak es un fraude, el reportero estrella de una revista masculina intenta desenmascararla, haciendo que se enamore de él...

programme.title: Señor y Señora Adelman
programme.desc: Sarah y Victor llevan juntos más de 45 años. ¿Cómo lo han conseguido? ¿Quién es en realidad Sarah, esa enigmática mujer que ha estado siempre a la sombra de su marido? El amor, la ambición y los secretos alimentan la odisea de esta pareja poco corriente.

programme.title: Algún día nos lo contaremos todo
programme.desc: Verano de 1990, antigua Alemania Oriental. María está a punto de cumplir 19 años y vive en la granja de los padres de su novio Johannes...

programme.title: The Penthouse
programme.desc: En la soleada Carolina Beach, el nuevo ático de Peter y Amanda tiene una vista magnífica del puerto deportivo. Un día observan a una pareja discutiendo a bordo de un velero atracado. Amanda se hace amiga de la asustada Tess, pero poco después desaparece sin dejar rastro.

programme.title: Quisiera que alguien me esperara en algún lugar
programme.desc: Aurore decide celebrar su 70º cumpleaños en su residencia de verano junto a sus 4 hijos. Uno de ellos tomará una decisión que cambiará sus vidas para siempre.

programme.title: Nueve vidas
programme.desc: El cineasta colombiano Rodrigo García vuelve a retratar el mundo femenino mostrando momentos especialmente cruciales y dramáticos en la vida de nueve mujeres, nueve vidas que son prisioneras de relaciones pasadas y presentes.

programme.title: Los signos del Apocalipsis
programme.desc: Cuando un misterioso planeta atraviesa el Sol, se desatan catástrofes globales. Un solitario científico es la clave para descifrar los símbolos, convirtiéndose en la única oportunidad que le queda a la humanidad para sobrevivir.

programme.title: El cortador de césped
programme.desc: Un científico logra incrementar de forma extraordinaria la inteligencia de un discapacitado intelectual mediante una combinació…

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Rivales
programme.desc: Dos equipos juveniles van a la final en Sevilla mientras se entrelazan historias familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: Amistad femenina enfrenta cáncer y embarazo.

programme.title: Un padre de cuidado
programme.desc: Tim Allen es Joe, un chico cuya vida ha ido constantemente cambiando para peor. Cuando el acosador de la oficina va demasiado lejos, Joe decide que es hora volverse a sí mismo de un don nadie en un alguien.

programme.title: Coffee Wars
programme.desc: Una barista vegana se enfrenta al mundo en el Campeonato Mundial de Baristas.

programme.title: Tyler Perry: Boo! A Madea Halloween
programme.desc: En la noche más espeluznante del año, Madea es convocada para vigilar a la hija adolescente de Brian y evitar que se meta en problemas.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Desesperado por una buena historia, un periodista adicto al sexo se sumerge en el mundo de las señoritas de compañía de lujo cuando comienza a seguirle los pasos a una prostituta licenciada en Stanford.

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Contratado para robar el fabuloso diamante Queen, el enano ladrón Calvin Sims (Marlon Wayans) y su tonto compañero Percy (Tracy Morgan) guardan la piedra en la bolsa de mano de Vanessa Edwards (Kerry Washington, Ray) cuando su plan de escape sale mal. Al descubrir al esposo de Vanessa, Darryl (Shawn Wayans), que está desesperado por ser padre, Calvin intercambia sus jugarretas por pañales y se hace pasar por un bebé abandonado. Sufriendo un número de graciosas humillaciones y salidas familiares, Calvin desesperadamente trata de recuperar la gema antes de que lo descubran, y Darryl y Vanessa no están ayudando en nada. Dirigida por Keenen Ivory Wayans (White Chicks).

programme.title: Paternidad
programme.desc: Kevin Hart protagoniza esta conmovedora historia real sobre un padre viudo que se enfrenta a dudas, miedos, angustias y pañales sucios mientras se dispone a criar a su hija por su cuenta.

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: Rogers y Clarke (Warren Beatty y Dustin Hoffman) son dos ineptos compositores sin suerte y desesperados por dinero. El dúo acepta el consejo de su sospechoso agente, y en un abrir y cerrar de ojos está en un recorrido por la mística república de Ishtar. A su llegada, nuestros héroes son reclutados por separado como espías de los bandos contrarios de una revolución planeada, y al mismo tiempo se disputan la atención de una hermosa revolucionaria (Isabelle Adjani). Sin embargo, Clarke y Rogers son peores espías que compositores, y en poco tiempo terminan varados en el desierto en compañía de un camello ciego y de varios asesinos de la CIA.

programme.title: Una Madre Imperfecta
programme.desc: La cinta nos cuenta la historia de Marnie (Susan Sarandon), una viuda no acostumbrada a su nueva situación emocional que decide recoger sus cosas y trasladarse a Hollywood con el objetivo de estar más cerca de su hija. No obstante, y sin quererlo, comienza a interferir en la vida de ésta, Lori (Rose Byrne). Es entonces cuando se ve obligada a empezar de nuevo desde el principio en un lugar desconocido encontrando por el camino nuevos amigos, nuevas experiencias y nuevas personas que la necesitan.

programme.title: El Ahorcado
programme.desc: Milagrosamente aún vivo después de su ahorcamiento, el pistolero James Devlin defiende la granja de una joven viuda de un vicioso acaparador de tierras.

programme.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un marshal y a un sheriff en un enfrentamiento con una sanguinaria banda de forajidos conocida como Los Sabuesos del Infierno, que han invadido su pequeño pueblo del este de Texas.

programme.title: Avanzada del Infierno
programme.desc: Un veterano de la guerra de Corea intenta ayudar al propietario de una mina de un pequeño pueblo, a desarrollar su mina de tungsteno a pesar de los esfuerzos del jefe del pueblo por detenerlo.

programme.title: 30 Winchester para El Diablo
programme.desc: El líder de los bandidos El Diablo, que controla el país con su banda, planea conseguir oro destinado a México, pero no es el único.

programme.title: Con el mal adentro
programme.desc: Dennis, un hombre con discapacidad mental, comienza a tener pesadillas tras la llegada de un espejo antiguo. Su reflejo lo obliga a matar, convirtiéndolo en un asesino en serie. Mientras tanto, Lydia, la novia de su hermano, se muda con ellos sin ver el peligro.

programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Traicionado por quienes más confiaba, un asesino a sueldo novato del gobierno descubre que ahora es el objetivo del sicario más letal del mundo. Sin aliados y contra el reloj, comienza un juego despiadado donde matar primero es la única forma de sobrevivir.

programme.title: El Chata
programme.desc: Aunque Samuel tiene talento de sobra para ser campeón de boxeo, parece destinado a recibir golpes como un saco de boxeo. Ahora, a sus treinta años, tiene que convertirse en sparring porque nadie está dispuesto a darle una oportunidad. Joe, su antiguo entrenador, que está entrenando a una nueva promesa, decide ponerle a prueba. Incapaz de alimentar a su familia y con las tentaciones encima, en lo único que puede pensar es en volver al ring y demostrarse a sí mismo y a todo el mundo, que el tiempo en prisión le ha cambiado, y que está decidido a recuperar a su familia y ganarse de nuevo el cariño de su hijo. De vuelta ya al barrio, la vida no le deja quitarse los guantes ni un segundo. Aunque la posibilidad de emigrar la ve como un renacer, Samuel sabe que, vaya donde vaya, el barrio siempre está dentro de uno.

programme.title: La última vida
programme.desc: Jason Stevens superó el camino hacia el “regalo definitivo”, pero ahora su legado es cuestionado. Con sus bienes embargados y su relación en crisis, enfrenta una batalla que podría costarle todo. Debe descubrir qué significa realmente cumplir su destino… y vivir.

programme.title: Espiando a los detectives
programme.desc: Un cinéfilo aficionado al cine negro en extremo prueba de su propia medicina y ve cómo su vida da un vuelco de la mano de una extraña mujer fatal con una gran aventura en mente. A veces el amor supera a la ficción.

programme.title: The Princess Blade
programme.desc: Yuki pertenece a un grupo de guerreros mercenarios, los Takemikazuchi, largamente empleados por el actual gobierno para vencer a la facción rebelde contrarios a su política déspota. Esta banda de samurais modernos se rige por un sólido código del honor mas cercano a las antiguas ordenes feudales que a una organización pseudo-criminal. Yuki, descendiente directa de la rama consanguínea de los fundadores del clan descubrirá que su madre fue asesinada por el actual dirigente del mismo cuando intentó poner fin a las maniobras de sus miembros. Consciente de ello Yuki se volverá contra sus camaradas y tendrá que liberarse de sus deberes para ser libre.

programme.title: La maldición (The Grudge)
programme.desc: Rika cuida a una anciana señora que vive en una casa en la que suceden cosas extrañas. Un día se encuentra en el piso de arriba a un niño de seis años que lleva un gato negro en los brazos...

programme.title: Ju-on (La maldición)
programme.desc: El pequeño Toshió no va a clase últimamente, por eso su profesor Mr. Kobayashi decide ir a su casa. Toshio está solo, en medio de un caos total. Sus padres no están y el profesor asume que han salido de compras. Pero en esta casa hay más de lo que se ve a simple vista.

programme.title: Arturo y Merlin: Los caballeros de Camelot
programme.desc: El Rey Arturo, mucho más viejo que cuando partió por primera vez, regresa a casa tras combatir al Imperio Romano. Su hijo ilegítimo ha corrompido el trono de Camelot, por lo que Arturo tendrá que reunirse con el mago Merlín y los Caballeros de la Mesa redonda para recuperar su corona.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: Creatura
programme.desc: Tras mudarse con su pareja a un nuevo hogar, Mila se da cuenta de que su pérdida de deseo se encuentra en sí misma. A partir de ahí, empieza un viaje en el que revisita experiencias de su infancia y adolescencia con la esperanza de reconciliarse con su propio cuerpo.

programme.title: La vergüenza
programme.desc: Pepe y Lucía no pueden con Manu. Lo han intentado todo, pero es inútil: el niño que adoptaron hace apenas un año les viene grande, no se hacen con él, y han decidido devolverlo. Sin embargo pronto se dan cuenta del precio que deberán pagar si quieren seguir adelante con su plan.

programme.title: Magical Girl

programme.title: Anacondas: La Caceria Por La Orquidea Sangrienta
programme.desc: Un pequeño equipo de investigación es enviado a la selva en busca de la versión en planta del 'Santo Grial'. El principal problema es que los poderes de la flor ya son utilizados por una hambrienta y poderosa serpiente.

programme.title: Xxx 2: Estado De Emergencia
programme.desc: En esta secuela atiborrada de acción del éxito de taquilla xXx, Ice Cube interpreta a Darius Stone, un liante en busca de subidones cuyos antecedentes policiales y su obsesión por los deportes extremos le convierten en candidato ideal para ser el próximo agente xXx. Debe salvar a Estados Unidos de una conspiración letal del general de cinco estrellas y Secretario de Defensa George Deckert (interpretado por Willem Dafoe). Solo un renegado agente xXx como Stone tiene las habilidades extremas para evitar que el peligroso grupo disidente del ejército tome el gobierno en la capital de Estados Unidos.

programme.title: No Respires
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de tres jóvenes que planifican a la perfección los robos que hacen de casa en casa. Cuando entran a uno de esos hogares, atacan al inquilino, un hombre ciego y solitario. Tan pronto como intentan huir de la casa, se cambian los roles y los jóvenes se encuentran luchando por su supervivencia contra el ciego.

programme.title: No Respires 2

programme.title: El mono borracho en el ojo del Tigre
programme.desc: ¡La comedia de kung fu original! Won Fei Hung (Jackie Chan) interpreta al travieso hijo de un profesor de artes marciales que no para de hacer el payaso cuando debería estar aprendiendo kung fu. Debido a una de sus bromas, el hijo de un poderoso vecino resulta herido y el padre de Fei Hung le pide ayuda a su sádico tío para que le enseñe a su hijo un poco de disciplina. Este extraño hombre, que tiene la reputación de lisiar a sus pupilos, intenta a enseñar a Fei Hung un extraño estilo de kung fu. Al principio, Fei Hung se resiste, pero tras perder una pelea contra un asesino contratado para matar a su padre, se da cuenta de que debe aprender el extraordinario arte del 'boxeador borracho'. DRUNKEN MASTER fue la segunda colaboración entre el director Yuen Wo Ping (el coreógrafo de lucha en The Matrix y Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon) y Jackie Chan. Su mezcla de complicadas llaves de artes marciales y la clásica comedia física de Jackie Chan, hace que DRUNKEN MASTER sea una de las películas precursoras del género de la comedias de kung fu y corona a Chan como su indiscutible rey.
